Description: CoherenceAnalyzer AWS footprint (SPEC section 14): S3 store bucket, Bedrock Guardrail for the explainer call only, least-privilege IAM managed policy. Educational simulation, no execution.

ModelArn.Description: ARN of the Bedrock model or inference profile used for BEDROCK_MODEL_ID. bedrock:InvokeModel is granted on this ARN and on FoundationModelId.

S3Prefix.Description: Key prefix the app may read and write, with a trailing slash (the app setting COHERENCE_ANALYZER_S3_PREFIX is the same value without the slash).

FoundationModelId.Description: Foundation model id behind ModelArn. A cross-region inference profile needs bedrock:InvokeModel on this model in every destination Region it routes to.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Store backend for COHERENCE_ANALYZER_STORE=s3 (SPEC section 10): profiles, events, reports, audit.
must: Keep public access blocked, encryption and versioning on
Retain on delete: audit records are evidence

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Encryption in transit for every request.

Properties.Description: Applied to the explainer call only. Denies personalised investment recommendations.
Properties.BlockedInputMessaging: Cette demande ne peut pas être traitée : l'outil ne donne pas de conseil en placement personnalisé. This request cannot be processed: the tool gives no personalised investment advice.
Properties.BlockedOutputsMessaging: Cette réponse a été bloquée : l'outil ne donne pas de conseil en placement personnalisé. This answer was blocked: the tool gives no personalised investment advice.

TopicsConfig.Name: Personalised-investment-recommendations
TopicsConfig.Definition: Recommendations addressed to the reader telling them to buy, sell, hold or reallocate a specific investment, or how they personally should invest their money.
Examples: Vous devriez vendre vos actions NVDA et acheter des obligations.
Je vous recommande d'acheter XBB pour réduire votre risque.
You should sell your NVDA shares and buy more bonds.
We recommend moving 10% of your portfolio into gold.
Buy QQQ now, it is the best choice for your profile.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: SPEC section 14: denied topic on the N5 explainer call only. v2 (2026-11-14): v1 blocked factual limit-vs-holding sentences and our own rules text on input; the topic now targets directives and runs on output only.
must: Never attach to N1, N3, N4 or N6 calls
Blocked messaging stays fixed text, never LLM output

Properties.Description: Explainer guardrail v2: denied topic narrowed to directives, evaluated on model output only

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: The app pins an immutable guardrail version in BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_VERSION.

Properties.Description: Least-privilege access for CoherenceAnalyzer: invoke one Bedrock model, apply one guardrail, read and write one S3 prefix.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: One least-privilege policy for whoever runs the app.
must: No action or resource wildcards beyond the one model id across inference-profile Regions
S3 access limited to the S3Prefix
